subproblem.title: Mass of a current with constant m-vector against a Radon measure
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P finite on compact sets, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) (a continuous linear functional on m-covectors, MultiVector P m) and s ∈ ℝ such that |ζ₀(α)| ≤ s·|α| for every m-covector α (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm) and ζ₀(β) = s for some β with |β| ≤ 1 (so s is the dual norm of ζ₀). If Ξ ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) satisfies Ξ(ω) = ∫ζ₀(ω(x))dν(x) for every test m-form ω, then M_W(Ξ) = s·ν(W) (in [0, ∞], s read as ofReal s) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P m) (s : ℝ) (Ξ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) m, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Ξ ω = ∫ x, ζ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂ν) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Ξ.massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal s * ν W
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, step 5(δ) (mass of Ξ(ω) := ∫⟨ω, ζ₀⟩dν′), which the parent also uses in step 10 in degree n − 1.
1. s ≥ 0. With β as in the statement, |s| = |ζ₀(β)| ≤ s|β|. If s < 0 the right side is ≤ 0, forcing |s| = 0, a contradiction. So s ≥ 0.
2. Upper bound. Let ω be admissible for M_W: a test m-form on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. The function x ↦ ζ₀(ω(x)) is continuous with compact support tsupport ω, hence bounded and ν-integrable (ν(tsupport ω) < ∞), and |ζ₀(ω(x))| ≤ s|ω(x)| ≤ s·1_{tsupport ω}(x) (it vanishes outside the support of ω). Therefore Ξ(ω) ≤ s·ν(tsupport ω) ≤ s·ν(W), so ofReal(Ξ(ω)) ≤ ofReal(s)·ν(W). Taking the supremum over admissible ω, M_W(Ξ) ≤ ofReal(s)·ν(W).
3. Exhaustion. Let K_j := {x ∈ W : |x| ≤ j and infDist(x, ℝ^P∖W) ≥ 1/j} (K_j := {|x| ≤ j} if W = ℝ^P): compact, increasing, ⋃_jK_j = W (W open). For each j there is a smooth compactly supported φ_j : ℝ^P → [0, 1] with φ_j = 1 on K_j and tsupport φ_j ⊆ W: cover the compact K_j by finitely many balls B(x, r_x) with B̄(x, 3r_x) ⊆ W, take smooth bumps ψ_x : ℝ^P → [0, 1] with ψ_x = 1 on B(x, r_x) and tsupport ψ_x ⊆ B(x, 2r_x) (Mathlib ContDiffBump), and put φ_j := h∘(Σ_xψ_x) with h : ℝ → [0, 1] smooth, h(0) = 0, h = 1 on [1, ∞) (e.g. Real.smoothTransition).
4. Lower bound. ω_j(x) := φ_j(x)·β is a test m-form with tsupport ω_j ⊆ tsupport φ_j ⊆ W and |ω_j(x)| = φ_j(x)|β| ≤ 1: it is admissible for M_W. Ξ(ω_j) = ∫φ_j(x)ζ₀(β)dν = s∫φ_j dν ≥ s·ν(K_j) (φ_j ≥ 1_{K_j}, s ≥ 0). Hence M_W(Ξ) ≥ ofReal(Ξ(ω_j)) ≥ ofReal(s)·ν(K_j) for all j, and ν(K_j) ↑ ν(W) (continuity from below), so M_W(Ξ) ≥ ofReal(s)·ν(W).
5. Steps 2 and 4 give M_W(Ξ) = ofReal(s)·ν(W). ∎
proof_key_steps: |ζ₀(ω(x))| ≤ s|ω(x)| bounds Ξ(ω) ≤ sν(W) for admissible ω.
Testing with φ_jβ, φ_j smooth cutoffs equal to 1 on compacts exhausting W, gives ≥ sν(W).

audit.reason: The hypotheses imply s ≥ 0. The admissible-form upper bound and compact-exhaustion cutoff lower bound prove the stated ENNReal mass equality, including s = 0.
